name: Suchodus
sum: Fully marine metriorhynchid from the Middle to Late Jurassic of England and France.
holotype: Not stated in the Wikipedia article consulted; check the original description.
material: The article consulted gives no specimen list; a skeletal reconstruction of NHMUK PV R 3804 exists on Commons.
biology: A large predator that would have fed on other large marine animals, with a streamlined body, powerful tail and long, robust jaws.
author: Lydekker 1890
